page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Two notes in the left margin: "GRONINGA." beside the line "GRO-NINGA", and "Aggeres fluitibus opposita." beside the start of the second paragraph. Page number and running head at the top, centred over the text. No catchword.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: vi, & cœnobia duo, ambiguo inter Drentiam & eam, quam jam exponimus, Frisiam jure, quibus se debere hinc atque inde decerptis quibusdam partibus coagmentatisque videtur: lingua tamen, legibus, institutis per multa nunc sæcula illam magis quàm hanc referens, & Vltrajectinum Præsulem olim summum Dominum agnoscens. Antiquissimi ejus rectores Gronenbergij feruntur: ab his ad Selverdios, à Selverdiis viciffim ad Vltrajectinos, Geldros, Burgundos ordine pervenit; Burgundi postremò senatui populoque Groningano, nihil imminuto veteri vicanorum jure ac libertate, attribuerunt. Atque hujus in solo, ubi arenis gleba pinguior jungitur, editiore in dorso inter camporum humilia lingua instar se porrigente, sedem habet G R o-GRONINGA.N I N G A nostra, de quà nunc scribimus potissimum, universæ regionis nunc descriptæ, ut & totius Drentiæ, commune velut horreum.
Regio universa ab exitu Lavicæ per ambages varias, quà æstuarium se curvat, quà Hunesus egreditur, quà vadum à septen-Aggeres fluitibus opposita.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment, "vi," (Roman numeral VI, shown as a small-letter form in print). The left-margin notes are the two lines printed in small type beside the text. The printed hyphen in "G R o-" and "N I N G A" is kept as printed. The final word "septen-" runs over to the next page and is left as a fragment. Running head and page number are printed at the top.
